flows.name: Guest chooses meal
flows.steps: Menu > filter vegetarian/no-nuts tag > dish details > choose size and extras > add to demo order > edit qty > see totals > create DEMO order copy > admin sees simulated order.
flows.oracle: Modifiers, availability, sum and currency exact.

flows.name: Group table preference
flows.steps: Locations > branch > choose party size 6 > view sample times > choose available slot > request table > REQUESTED receipt.
flows.oracle: Unavailable slots do not accept new requests.

flows.name: Allergen conflict
flows.steps: Dish tagged nuts visible > no-nuts filter hides it > reset reveals item
flows.oracle: No wrong allergen tags or dangerous safety promises.

design: Tactile warm food editorial; cream #F6F0E4, burnt cinnamon #AC5239, deep olive #3C4A35. Rich food photography, handwritten-like small markers, oversized menu typography, playful menu sheet transitions. Different from fashion store, less catalog-grid more menu-list.
signatureFeatures: Category/dietary/allergen filter with accurate ingredient metadata
Dish customization (size, protein, extras) tied to item pricing and availability
Demo order builder with calculated total and copyable sample order text
Table request with party size, future preference and available sample slots
Location/hours and editorial sourcing story without fabricated reviews
seedRequirements: 30 dishes across 6 menu categories, 12 modifiers, 3 fictional branches, 14 sample time slots with some unavailable, 4 food editorial stories, 10 FAQs, 4 dietary tags; per-dish allergen fields.
adminRequirements: Menu categories/dishes/ingredients/allergen metadata, pricing/modifiers, branch hours/sample slots, example orders and table requests, editorial articles. Updating a dish price recalculates cart server-side.
negativeScenarios: Large dish 220 EGP + extras 35 and quantity 2 = 510 EGP before fees
No-nuts filter excludes an explicit nuts dish
Example branch Friday opening hours differ and slots follow schedule
Restaurant demo order receipt says no kitchen submission
